original_test_intent: Verify uncorrectable non-fatal DRAM handling for every required slot, including attributable logging, the approved containment/restart behavior and complete post-event recovery.
original_method: Map populated slots to safe owned addresses; select one approved BIOS profile; resolve whether non-fatal UCE should preserve service or intentionally restart; perform one supervised injection per target; correlate tool, MCA/APEI or WHEA, rasdaemon, BMC/UEFI and console evidence; recover, check memory integrity and restore state.
manual_activity: The FAE resolves non-fatal disposition, maps each slot address, selects the BIOS profile, runs one UCE at a time, owns restart/recovery and restores BIOS/HDT/injector state.
required_inputs: Slot/UMC/channel/rank/address map and safe reserved page per target
Authoritative non-fatal containment versus shutdown/restart decision and timing
Backup, abort, OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with OOB console
Never inject unmapped 0x1000 or apply both profiles by assumption
One mapped UCE per approval; stop on wrong slot, fatal escalation, unexpected restart, persistent poison or failed boot
No automatic retry/recovery; disable injection and restore all state
agent_execution_scope: Validate map, package, profile, disposition and recovery plan; collect read-only evidence
Do not choose address/profile, change BIOS/HDT, inject, reset/retry or decide verdict

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 0x1000/mask/mcapolling/errortype 1, both profiles, slot 1~N, shutdown/restart and 60/120 minutes are preserved but not assumed correct.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one attributable UCE-nonfatal checkpoint per mapped slot with explicit service-versus-restart acceptance and full recovery proof.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe address ownership, profile choice, disposition timing, OS-specific evidence and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One unmapped address and tool PASS cannot prove all slots or the intended non-fatal response.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong address/profile/severity may create fatal poison, reset loops or unbootable memory.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The test calls the event non-fatal yet mandates shutdown/restart without defining policy. It claims slots 1~N but uses one unmapped 0x1000 address, presents contradictory counter profiles, omits timeout, requires dmesg on Windows, and DeepSeek retains copied correctable wording.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The UCE non-fatal slot intent is identifiable; engineering can define disposition, mapping and profile, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 43 Wistron-System RAS-00763-V003: define whether uncorrectable non-fatal handling preserves service or requires shutdown/restart and its timing; provide slot/UMC/rank safe-address mapping, DRAM-versus-MCA profile decision, AMD tool/spec provenance and errortype=1 semantics, per-slot Linux/Windows/BMC oracle, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Separates non-fatal acceptance from an unexplained restart and makes slot coverage address-attributable with recoverable one-shot execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Non-fatal describes error severity/containment, not automatically the platform power response; mandatory restart therefore needs an explicit policy oracle. Physical-address injection proves a slot only after interleave/hash decoding and safe page ownership. Tool PASS means stimulus acceptance, not correct containment. Because an errortype-1 event can poison memory or escalate, each slot needs independent recovery and no chained retry.
